description: Runs Playwright tests on Endform from a local project, as `endform test` does when run in the given directory. Omit testFileFilters, grep, grepInvert, and project to run the whole suite. Returns as soon as the suite has started, with a suiteRunId for suite_run_status and suite_run_stop. The run carries on in the background on this machine.

config.description: Playwright configuration file or test directory, like Playwright `--config`. Relative paths resolve against `directory`.

directory.description: Absolute path of the directory to run from, as if `endform test` were started there.

grep.description: Only selects tests whose full Playwright title chain matches these regular expressions, including the project, file, describe blocks, and test title.

grepInvert.description: Excludes tests with titles matching these regular expressions, like Playwright `--grep-invert`.

maxFailures.description: Stops the suite after this many failures. Defaults to the Playwright config, and 0 removes the limit.

organizationId.description: Endform organization ID. Defaults to the organization configured for the repository or active login.

project.description: Only selects tests from these Playwright projects, like Playwright `--project`.

repeatEach.description: Runs each selected test this many times, like Playwright `--repeat-each`. To measure how flaky a test is, select it, set retries to 0, and repeat it, for example 100 times before a fix and 100 times after.

retries.description: Maximum retries for each failed test. Defaults to the Playwright config.

testFileFilters.description: Filters test files using regular expressions matched against absolute paths, like Playwright positional test filters. A filter may include a test declaration line, for example `tests/checkout.spec.ts:47`.

name: suite_run_start

flaking.description: Tests with a failed attempt that are waiting on a retry right now. This is 0 once the run is over: a test that passed on retry counts as passed.
